display.purpose: Existing cartoon headings and Level 4 sign.

label.purpose: Existing cinematic and boss HUD labels after CartoonUI.Typography.

safeArea.behavior: Normalizes Screen.safeArea; reapplies on resolution or safe-area changes. Both Level 4 components use it.

assets.constraint: Keep original portrait and metadata intact. Generated composition is a reference, not shipped art or background.

native.extractionLimit: No synthesized tonal ramps, HTML/CSS previews or browser breakpoints. Unity source owns numeric color values; DESIGN.md frontmatter carries their percentage equivalents.
native.validationLimit: Source extraction only. Unity render captures are not actual Android-device proof. No device validation, performance guarantee or finish-review verdict is asserted.

narrative.overview: Existing Unity cartoon UI uses cream lettering, dark ink and frames, wood signage and gold accents. Game health uses red. This extraction preserves the established art and UI; it introduces no visual system changes.
dos: Do reuse the Unity canvas, safe-area, typography and frame helpers.
Do keep the original Boss_Base PNG and metadata intact; use the generated composition only as reference.
Do treat Unity render captures as Unity evidence, not actual Android-device proof.
donts: Don't translate virtual Unity layout units into CSS pixels or impose HTML components.
Don't invent palette ramps, typography scales, breakpoints or branding promises.
Don't edit gameplay scripts, global source, scenes, art or metadata for this documentation handoff.
